title: Law to require DOB to remind owners about permit sign-offs
summary: This bill would require the Department of Buildings to email property owners a notice about permit sign-off requirements within seven days of a permit's issuance, and then every 90 days until sign-off is received. If a permit is close to expiring or has expired, DOB would have to send the notice every two weeks until sign-off. The notice must include the permit number, expiration date and consequences of not obtaining sign-off, such as reinstatement fees and effects on future permits or property sales.
